boundary: The C4 graph phase is not itself a unique physical U(1). It permits compatible linear complex structures, but most choices remain gauge-dependent.

clock_C4.canonicality: Existence is exact, but a full C4-invariant J is noncanonical on the trivial and sign multiplicity spaces. The paired V9 swap J is canonical after the two literal intertwiner gauges are fixed.

exceptional_S6.commutant_algebra: M2(R) x M3(R) x M2(R) x M2(R) x R x R
exceptional_S6.obstruction: The real-type isotypic multiplicities 3,1,1 are odd.

theorem: The full exceptional-S6 commutant of 24+90 has dimension 23 and forbids a complex structure on the whole carrier, while its paired natural V9 block carries an exact S6-equivariant J. Restriction to the residual clock subgroup C4 removes the full-sector obstruction: both 24 and 90 admit C4-invariant complex structures.
